props.gloss_en: the Holy One, blessed be He, wears tefillin
the source: 'the Lord has sworn by His right hand and by the arm of His strength' (Isa 62:8) -- one swears by holy objects
'by His right hand' is the Torah -- 'from His right hand, a fiery law for them' (Deut 33:2)
the source for right-hand = Torah: Deut 33:2
'the arm of His strength' is tefillin -- 'the Lord gives strength to His people' (Ps 29:11)
the source for arm-of-strength = tefillin: Ps 29:11
tefillin are strength for Israel
the source: 'and all the peoples of the earth shall see that the name of the Lord is called upon you, and they shall fear you' (Deut 28:10)
R' Eliezer HaGadol's baraita: 'the name of the Lord is called upon you' -- these are the tefillin of the head
what is written in the tefillin of the Master of the world?
written in them: 'and who is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land' (I Chr 17:21)
and is the Holy One glorified through the glory of Israel?
yes -- the Holy One is glorified through the glory of Israel
the source: the juxtaposed 'you have affirmed the Lord this day' and 'the Lord has affirmed you this day' (Deut 26:17-18)
the Holy One said to Israel: you made Me a single entity in the world, and I will make you a single entity in the world
'you made Me one entity' -- from 'Hear, Israel, the Lord our God, the Lord is One' (Deut 6:4)
'I will make you one entity' -- from 'who is like Your people Israel, one nation in the land'
that accounts for one compartment; what is in the other compartments?

Rav Ashi: the other compartments hold 'for who is a great nation' (Deut 4:7), 'and who is a great nation' (4:8), 'happy are you, Israel' (33:29), 'or has God attempted' (4:34), 'and to elevate you' (26:19)

the arrangement: 'for who is a great nation' and 'and who is a great nation', which resemble each other, in one compartment; 'happy are you, Israel' and 'who is like Your people Israel' in one; 'or has God attempted' in one; 'and to elevate you' in one
and all of them are written [together] in the arm-tefillin

supports.gloss_en: ותניא, רבי אליעזר הגדול אומר: אלו תפילין שבראש -- the verse's 'name of the Lord called upon you' is the head-tefillin, so the verse says tefillin are Israel's strength

objections.gloss_en: אי הכי, נפישי להו טובי בתי? -- if so, there are too many compartments: five verses beyond ומי כעמך, but a head-tefillin has four

answered_by.gloss_en: אלא -- the two 'great nation' verses, which resemble each other, share a compartment; אשריך ישראל shares one with ומי כעמך; או הנסה and ולתתך עליון take one each: four compartments
